Hi
it appears that in the latest master something necessary to the working of SparkR happens when attaching it. Re: Can not import SparkR

So we need to pick up the install path of the SparkR package to figure out where the JAR file is – This happens right now in sparkR.onLoad https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/master/pkg/R/sparkR.R#L5 which is called by .onAttach https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/blob/master/pkg/R/zzz.R#L1

If we change this to be called .onLoad , will that solve your use case ?
